Subject: Hosting modes and quick pilot sizing follow-up

Hi James — great to meet yesterday. I promised a short note summarizing the hosting modes we typically advise for regulated workloads and a couple of quick questions so we can size a sensible pilot.

High-level options we usually present:
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): predictable throughput, SLA-backed latency, faster onboarding (we own the infra).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full data isolation and customer-managed networking; longer lead time and procurement.

Questions for sizing:
1) Expected peak concurrent requests (RPS) for the pilot and target P95 latency.
2) Typical sequence length / tokens per request (median and 95th).
3) Any encryption/HSM requirements beyond standard KMS?

If you prefer, we can propose two concrete slates (minimal pilot vs production tilt) and price deltas. I attached a small worksheet that shows how we map concurrency -> GPU counts for both Dedicated and Private slates.

Attachments: borealis_initial_slate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,

Subject: Hosting recommendation & pilot options — Dedicated vs Private (summary)

James — thanks for the clear targets. Below are two pragmatic options that align with your timeline and compliance needs. I've kept the ask minimal so procurement can move quickly.

Option A — Dedicated (recommended for pilot velocity)
- Pilot configuration (12-week): 8 x A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs (continuous batching + KV caching).
- Expected perf: P95 ~220–280ms at 120 RPS bursts (depends on prompt set; we can tune batch sizes).
- Security: SOC2 + audit logs + optional CMEK (customer-managed keys) for hosted metadata.
- Lead time: 7–10 business days to provision dedicated pool and route traffic.
- Commercial: usage + a small 12-week reservation fee; escape hatch to Private with a contract amendment.

Option B — Private VPC (for full isolation; production-ready)
- Pilot configuration (12-week proof): 4 x H100-equivalent GPUs deployed into your VPC.
- Expected perf: P95 ~200–260ms at 120 RPS bursts (lower latency per-GPU but fewer GPUs => more aggressive scheduling).
- Security: SOC2, KMS/HSM integrations, VPC peering, enhanced audit retention (longer retention available as add-on).
- Lead time: ~4–8 weeks (procurement + network + runbook).
- Commercial: higher one-time setup fee; lower monthly unit uplift at scale.

Trade-offs (short):
- Speed to pilot: Dedicated wins (fast, lower friction).
- Long-term cost: Private can be cheaper for steady, high-volume usage but has higher upfront ops/procurement.
- SLAs: Comparable; dedicated gives faster remediation SLA because we own the infra stack.

I attached a short pricing PDF and a drive link for the migration playbook. Proposed next steps:
1) Letter of intent / 12-week pilot PO (we can accept a simple PO intent to start provisioning).
2) Kickoff call: Thu 2027-09-17 or Mon 2027-09-20 — 30 minutes to align security checklist.
